name: smith seated two hand shoulder press
description: A seated, two-handed shoulder press on the Smith machine's fixed bar path.
instructions: Place a bench beneath the Smith bar and sit upright with your feet planted.
Take a two-handed overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unhook the bar.
Press the bar upward along the rails until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower it under control to around chin or upper-chest height, then repeat and rerack.
